info.title: Grandway Policy-Registered API
info.description: Generated from the Core Policy Engine registry (source of truth for endpoints, permission keys, HTTP methods, and risk levels). Request/response body schemas are documented per app in `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List every applicant. Shared across the consultancy — not owner-scoped. Searchable by name, email, contact number, and passport number, and filterable by destination country and journey stage.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Create an applicant directly, with no preceding lead. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one applicant with contacts, addresses, passport, family, and emergency contacts.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct identity, contact, address, passport, family, or emergency-contact information.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List an applicant's chronological change history from the central audit log.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Set the applicant's standing: active, dormant, or archived. Always manual.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List, search, and filter the central audit log (Admin/Superadmin).

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Return the distinct app, action, entity type, and actor type values present in the audit log, for populating the log screen's filter controls (Admin/Superadmin).

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Retrieve a single audit event by id (Admin/Superadmin).

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Authenticate with username + password (+ device_id) and open a revocable session.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Revoke the caller's current session (logout of this device).

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Return the currently authenticated user and forced-password-change state.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Disable the caller's own MFA after confirming password + a current code.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Create a pending TOTP device and return its secret + otpauth URL.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Confirm a pending TOTP enrollment with a current code, activating MFA.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Change the caller's own password after confirming the current one.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Rotate the refresh session, issuing a new access + refresh credential.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the caller's own active sessions.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Revoke one, all-but-current, or all of the caller's own sessions.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List accounts within the caller's managed authority tier.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Create a subordinate account (superadmin→admin, admin→lead manager).

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve a single managed account.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Edit permitted profile fields of a managed account.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Deactivate a managed account and revoke its sessions.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List authentication audit events for a managed account.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Remove a managed account's MFA device and revoke its sessions.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Set a temporary password on a managed account and revoke its sessions.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Reactivate a blocked managed account.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List a managed account's active sessions.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Revoke one or all active sessions of a managed account.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one site with its institution and availability.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a site's name, city, notes, or availability. The owning institution is immutable; a non-active status requires a note.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List destination countries with their availability.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a destination country. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one country with its availability and counselling notes.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a country's name, notes, or availability. Setting a non-active status requires a note. The code is immutable.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the study-area classifications used to group and search programs.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a study-area classification. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one study-area classification.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a study field's name, ordering, or active flag. The code is immutable.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List providers, filterable by country, type, availability, and name search.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a provider under an existing country. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one provider with its country and availability.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a provider's name, type, country, notes, or availability. Setting a non-active status requires a note.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List one institution's sites. Nested under the institution that owns them.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a site to a provider. The institution comes from the URL and never changes. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
The shortlisting search. Filters by country, institution, campus, level, field, availability, scholarship, tuition ceiling, and free-text query. Returns only usable records unless asked otherwise.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a study offering under an institution, with optional campus, tuition, entry expectations, and scholarship notes. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one program with its full entry expectations, tuition caveats, and notes.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a program's classification, duration, intake, tuition, entry expectations, scholarship, or availability. The institution is immutable; a campus must belong to it; a tuition amount requires a currency and period.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List checklists with their progress counts. Filter by applicant, journey, status, origin, assignee, country, template, or overdue. journey_missing_checklist=true switches to the safety net: journeys naming a country nobody has authored requirements for.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Apply a template to a journey by hand, or start a blank checklist. The automatic path needs no endpoint — setting a journey's country inherits its country's list on its own.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the country requirement lists. Filter by country, status, default flag, or label. Readable by Admin and Lead Manager; only an Admin may author one.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Author a country's requirement list. Marking it the active default makes it the list every future applicant bound for that country inherits automatically. Admin authority only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one template with every requirement it defines, retired ones included.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a template's label, country, default flag, or status. Applicants already holding a copy are untouched — instantiation is a snapshot. The key is immutable. Admin authority only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add one requirement to a country's list — a document to collect, a stage to reach, or a task to perform. Affects who inherits it next, never anyone already holding a copy. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a requirement definition, or retire it with is_active=false. Never deleted: live checklist items point back at the definition they were copied from. Admin authority only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one checklist with every item, its progress counts, and its lifecycle stamps.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a checklist's title, owner, due date, or notes. Status is refused here — it moves only through the lifecycle actions, so completion cannot bypass the required-items check.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Put a draft checklist into active work. Inherited checklists arrive active already.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Take a checklist out of active work. A reason is required. An archived checklist no longer blocks re-applying its template, so this is also how staff ask for a fresh copy.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Declare an applicant's requirements met. Refused while any required item is pending or blocked, and the refusal names every offending item. Completion is derived, never asserted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Add a requirement to one applicant's checklist for the case the template did not anticipate. It never travels back to the template, so the next applicant is unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct an item's label, owner, due date, or description. Status is refused here — it moves only through the status endpoint, where the note and evidence rules live.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Mark a requirement completed, waived, blocked, or not applicable, with an optional uploaded file as evidence. Waiving or blocking requires a note; evidence must belong to this applicant.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Return a completed checklist to active work and clear its completion stamps. The completion itself survives in the audit log.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Return an archived checklist to work — active if it was ever activated, draft otherwise.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Browse the B2B partner directory. Shared — every Admin and Lead Manager may read it.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a partner organization to the directory, with its spokesperson and contact numbers.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one client with its full contact details, numbers, and standing.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a client's name, spokesperson, contact details, or notes. Standing is unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List a client's chronological change history from the central audit log.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Return a retired partner to current use, clearing the retirement state.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Withdraw a partner from current use, recording why. Nothing is deleted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
The recent-activity feed, projected from the central audit log. Paginated, newest first, and not narrowed by the caller's authority — the audit log is not owner-scoped.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Work that is stuck: blocked checklist items, journeys whose destination has no authored requirements, expiring passports, offers past their deadline, and rejected files.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Intake mix by lead source, and the lead-to-applicant, applicant-to-journey, journey-to-offer, and offer-acceptance rates for the window.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

How work ended over the window: journey outcomes, offer decisions, and archived or closed volumes. Windowed on when each thing ended, not when it started.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Stage and status counts across leads, applicants, journeys, offers, checklists, documents, and file verification. Every bucket is zero-filled.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Top-line alert counts and volumes across leads, applicants, journeys, offers, checklists, and files. The strip a user reads first.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Overdue and due-soon work: checklist items, offers awaiting a response, files awaiting verification, stalled documents, and leads nobody has followed up.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Open leads, checklist items, and offers awaiting a response, per staff member. A Lead Manager sees only their own row for leads; an Admin sees the distribution.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

List one document's print snapshots, newest version first. Bodies are omitted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Freeze the document's current body and render context as a new immutable version.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List one document's print timeline: captures, reprints, and recoveries, newest first.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Retrieve one frozen snapshot in full. The only endpoint that returns a snapshot body.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Restore a frozen body into the working document. The snapshot itself is never altered.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Record a reprint of an existing snapshot. Creates a print event, never a new snapshot.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List signatory records. Filter with ?status=active for the certificate signer picker.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a person and signature image to the library. Created as draft.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one signatory record, including its signature image link.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a signatory's names, title, role, or signature link. Status is unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Move a signatory between draft, active, and inactive. Nothing is deleted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List template catalogue rows. Filter by family and status to build the document picker.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Register a template slug against a family. The key is immutable once created.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one template catalogue row.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Edit a template's label, description, family, or display order. The key is refused.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Move a template between draft, active, and inactive. Existing documents are unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List document working records across applicants and standalone documents. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Open a new editable document against an applicant, or as a standalone record.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List applicants with live documents, each with a count and the most recent edit.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Retrieve one document including its full body. The only endpoint that returns content.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Save the workspace — label, body, notes. Owner, family, template, and status are unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Retire a document from active work with a mandatory reason. Nothing is deleted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List a document's chronological history. Body changes appear as a marker, not as content.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Return an archived document to draft so it can be edited again.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Move a document between draft and ready. Cannot set archived.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List file records. Filter by owner (applicant, journey, offer, document, snapshot), category, verification status, archive state, or checksum.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Store one file against exactly one business record. Multipart. Validated for size, extension, and leading bytes; created as pending.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one file's metadata. Never returns the bytes or the storage path.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a file's category or notes. Every other field is refused.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Retire a file from active work. A reason is required. Nothing is deleted and the version chain is unaffected. Admin authority only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Stream the stored bytes as an attachment. The only path from the storage volume to a client, and the only read in the project that writes an audit event.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Supersede this file with a newer one. Multipart. Creates a new record inheriting the owner and category, starting pending; the predecessor is kept.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Return an archived file to active work. Admin authority only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Record a verdict on a file: verified or rejected. Rejecting requires a reason. Admin authority only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Return the whole replacement chain containing this file, oldest first. Unpaginated.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

List study objectives across all applicants. Shared, not owner-scoped.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Record a new overseas-study objective for an existing applicant.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one journey with its objective details and lifecycle state.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct destination, level, field, intake, budget, or notes. Stage is unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
End a journey with a mandatory outcome. Successful completes it; anything else closes it.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Pause a journey to a later intake, recording the target intake and reason.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List a journey's chronological action history from the central audit log.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Return a completed, closed, or deferred journey to an active stage.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Move a journey between active stages. Cannot set completed, closed, or deferred.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List leads in the caller's scope: own leads for a Lead Manager, all for an Admin. Searchable by name, email, and contact number.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Record a new enquiry. The creator owns the lead permanently.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the configurable reasons a lead may be closed with.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a configurable loss reason. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Edit or deactivate a loss reason. Admin only; entries are never deleted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the configurable lead sources a lead may be attributed to.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Add a configurable lead source. Admin only.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Edit or deactivate a lead source. Admin only; entries are never deleted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve a single in-scope lead with its contact numbers and study interest.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct identity, contact, source, or study-interest information. Stage is unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Create an applicant and an initial journey from the lead, link both permanently, and move the lead to its terminal converted stage. Admin only; idempotent.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Record that manual follow-up occurred, optionally with a note and a stage change.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List a lead's chronological action history from the central audit log.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Close a lead as lost with a mandatory reason. Nothing is deleted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the notes recorded against a lead, newest first.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Append a note to a lead. Notes are append-only — there is no edit or delete.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Return a lost or converted lead to an active stage, preserving all history.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Move a lead between active stages. Cannot set lost or converted.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
The caller's own alert feed, newest first. Filter by status, read state, type, priority, source app, source record, or due bucket, and narrow by date or fiscal year. Scoped to the calling user — no authority can read another user's feed through the API.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Mark every unread notification on the caller's own feed read, and return how many changed. Clears everything unread rather than a priority-scoped subset, so the badge the user asked to clear actually reaches zero. Nothing is dismissed or resolved.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Unread count plus active totals by priority and by due bucket, for the calling user. Exists so a client rendering a bell badge is not forced to page the whole feed.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

One notification from the caller's own feed. A notification belonging to another user returns 404 rather than 403, so an id cannot be probed for existence on somebody else's feed.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Record that one of the caller's notifications needs no action. Writes an audit event. Permanent in effect: a dismissed alert keeps its deduplication key, so no later sweep raises the same condition again. Refuses an already dismissed or resolved notification.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Mark one of the caller's notifications read. Idempotent — a second call keeps the original timestamp, because the receipt answers when it was first seen. Does not change the notification's status: reading is not deciding.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

Return one of the caller's notifications to unread. Offered because an inbox without it punishes clicking through a list — the user who opens something they cannot deal with now needs a way to put it back.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List admission decisions across journeys. Shared, not owner-scoped.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Record an institution's admission decision against an applicant journey.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct a condition's type, wording, due date, or ordering. Status is unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

post.description:
Mark a condition satisfied, waived, not applicable, or pending again.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
Retrieve one offer with its snapshot, money figures, conditions, and decision.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

patch.description:
Correct dates, tuition, scholarship, deposit, or notes. Snapshot and status are unaffected.

Request/response field schemas: see the owning app's `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`.

get.description:
List the requirements attached to one offer, in display order.
